definitions.full: H6507. perudah [ מְּרֻדָה ] noun feminine grain of seed (?) (properly, si vera lectio, the separated ; compare Syriac , , Talmud מְּרִידָא , pebble, berry ); — only plural מְּרֻדוֺת Joel 1:17 .
